Forman yields the integral wedge types; no higher-cell attaching maps can be nontrivial over a single 0-cell.

value.rationale: Five consecutive natural finite instances of a current three-row matching-complex problem now have exact, independently reproducible *perfect discrete-Morse matchings* rather than homology-only data or a proof depending on the 2021 retracted recurrence.
